about: Lore-required standing water the base terrain does not hold on its own. The graph derive appends each as a body with origin 'authored'; the terrain stage (16b) digs it to the terrainPrecondition. Feeder channels are authored waterways (16b), appended to the graph by the extension rule.

bodies.lore: Blackrose stands on a lake with three canon water approaches: rivers from the NE (Murkwood) and W (Blackwood) and the S outlet to Oliis Bay (world/sources/lore; refine_province.FEEDER_SECTORS).

island.note: the city island, offset up to 20 m from centre

bodies.source: refine_province.impose_blackrose_lake (BLACKROSE_UV 0.32/0.87, LAKE_RADII_M, LAKE_BED_M, ISLAND_R_M, ISLAND_TOP_M); level measured on the shipped water 2026-09-11 (largest body in the lake window)
